command:
cd /tmp && cat > search3.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
search() {
  slug="$1"; shift
  q="$1"
  n=$(curl -s --max-time 15 -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:apache/echarts+type:pr+in:title+$q" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('\n'.join(str(i['number'])+' '+i['title'] for i in d.get('items',[])[:3]))" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "=== $slug =>"
  echo "$n"
  sleep 8
}
search lines-loop-symbol-flip "loop+end"
search marker-z-option "markPoint+z"
search matrix-dimension-length "matrix.length"
search matrix-label-formatter "matrix+formatter"
search parallel-axis-extent "parallel+extent"
search pie-tangential-noflip "noflip"
search radar-blur-itemstyle "blur+not+working"
search radar-clockwise-option "clockwise"
EOF
bash search3.sh
